locator.section: 8 / Detailed Mechanisms of Ion Fragmentation (Random or hidden rearrangements)

evidence.curator_note: Equation 8.7, row 2 (first bracketed ion-molecule complex, arrows drawn inside the bracket). Intra-complex proton transfer: the 1-butene C=C pi attacks the enol O-H proton (forming a new C-H bond, giving a sec-butyl cation) while the O-H bonding pair collapses onto oxygen as a new lone pair, leaving a neutral vinyloxy radical CH2=CH-O.. Book draws 2 arc(s), both full (double-barbed, 2-electron) curved arrows, and BOTH are drawn (moves 1,2); no implicit hook. DRAWN COMPLEX: reactant and product are square-bracketed non-covalent ion-molecule complexes; encoded here as two-species states {1-butene, CH2=CH-OH+.} -> {sec-butyl cation, CH2=CH-O.} since a proton-bound/ion-dipole complex is not a single valid mapped SMILES. The oxygen radical count is unchanged (O+. -> O.), so the arrow check reports a soft lone-pair note on atom 7 (the 2 e- arriving on O form a lone pair, not two radicals) -- this is expected and advisory. The species undergoing reaction is the isomerized molecular-ion complex (composition C6H12O, m/z 100).

Cross-link (PARTIAL): MØD rule IMS_8_7_4 (rule_name 'Hydrogen exchange occring in a Ion-Molecule-Complex 8.7 row 3 process 1'). DFS: [C]1[C]2[C.]3[C]4[C]5[C]6([H]7){=}[O+]8[H]9 >> [C]1[C]2([H]9)[C+]3[C]4[H]7.[C]5{=}[C]6[O.]8. The rule is a COLLAPSED NET transformation applied to the distonic ion (their C3 radical), folding the beta-cleavage (step c) AND this proton transfer AND an additional carbonyl-H (their H7) migration onto the butyl chain into a single rule; it also places the + on the former gamma carbon and produces the vinyloxy radical [C]5{=}[C]6[O.]8. This record encodes only the drawn intra-complex proton transfer (OH proton -> alkene), so it corresponds to IMS_8_7_4 at finer granularity and does not reproduce the rule's extra H7 exchange -- listed in rule_mismatches as a granularity/scope difference, not a geometry error. The vinyloxy radical product matches the rule.
